name: Starter imagery
_note: Abstract, hue-neutral placeholder art generated by scripts/library/make-starter-imagery.js, so a new project is never one where "the page has no picture" is the only option. Reference a file as noodl_modules/starter-imagery/<name>.svg from an Image src or a Group backgroundImage. It carries no stylesheet and injects nothing. REPLACE THESE with your own pictures — they are deliberately abstract and colourless so they do not fight whichever palette the project ends up wearing, which is also why they will never look as good as the real thing.
